description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Sign in: For those using SSO with EKS/GKE/AKS, when the session expires or invalid, Aptakube will now show a Sign in with ... button that launches the SSO sign in process for you, so you no longer have to switch between the app and a terminal session to authenticate.
💎 Improvements
- Performance: Aptakube went on a diet and is now about 30% smaller than before. This reduction in size also means it starts faster.
  - macOS (.dmg): 32.7 MB → 23.5 MB (−28%)
  - Windows (.msi): 16.6 MB → 11.5 MB (−31%)
  - Linux (.deb): 17 MB → 12.1 MB (−29%)
